description: Submit up to 10 SDS PDFs (public https URLs) as one asynchronous job. Returns a job_id; poll get_bulk_job until status is completed or failed. Reuse the same idempotency_key when retrying so no duplicate job is created. Billed per document from prepaid credit, reserved up front and released for any file that fails. Requires an API key.

callback_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed webhook when the job finishes.

file_urls.description: Public https URLs of SDS PDFs.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen unique key; a repeat returns the existing job.

name: submit_bulk_extraction
title: Submit a bulk extraction job
